change_log.value: Defined schema/contract story for board certification
Defined core logic for board certification extraction

stories.title: Define Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for board certification data derived from NPI registry including certification status, board name, specialty alignment, and verification flag.

stories.title: Implement Board Certification Extraction and Verification Logic
stories.description: Parse NPI registry response to extract board certification signals, normalize board names, and determine verification status based on available credential fields.

stories.title: Expose Board Certification via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate board certification data into provider detail response and expose through evaluate_care_facade for downstream consumption in chat responses.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Board Certification Verification
stories.description: Create tests validating extraction, normalization, and end-to-end propagation of board certification data from NPI lookup through facade response.
